'''Riss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he was wounded trying to protect a group of refugess from a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]]. He offered to give the Hunter the information he was after in exchange for letting the civilians go free, before succumbing to his wounds.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Riss appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Bounty Hunter class mission on Taris.
